content: {"records":[{"content":"At RAN1#100(e), the following were agreed on UL Tx switching (inter-band UL CA): (1) Agreement: For inter-band UL CA, if uplink Tx switching is configured, UE is not expected to be scheduled or configured with UL transmissions that result in simultaneous 1Tx transmission on carrier 1 and 2Tx transmission on carrier 2. (2) Working Assumption: For inter-band UL CA, if option 2 is supported, sub-option 2-3 is defined (minimize RAN1 impact; no new RAN4 impact; no new TDM pattern; can be revisited in a future RAN1 meeting taking into account any relevant RAN4 decisions on DL interruption for UL Tx switching) — Option 2-3: Case 1 = 1 Tx on carrier 1 and 1 Tx on carrier 2; Case 2 = 0 Tx on carrier 1 and 2 Tx on carrier 2. (3) Agreement: For inter-band UL CA, if UL switching period is configured by RRC, the switching period is not always applicable on the carrier configured with switching period; the switching period is at least applicable between 1-port transmission in carrier 1 and 2-port transmission in carrier 2. (4) Agreement: For inter-band UL CA, UE is not expected to [be scheduled or configured to] transmit on any of the two carriers in the switching period; FFS whether to handle the case when switching period cannot be ensured by gNB. (5) It was agreed that if uplink Tx switching is triggered, the length of the additional time for PUSCH preparation procedure equals the length of the UL switching period."}],"abstain":false,"complete":true}
